name: PostgreSQL
description: Connects to a PostgreSQL database via a REST proxy (PostgREST or platform DB proxy), supports full and incremental cursor-based sync.
author: OnePlatform

proxyUrl.description: Base URL of the Postgres REST proxy (e.g. PostgREST, pgweb, or the platform DB proxy). Must be HTTPS.

table.description: Table name to sync records from.

incrementalColumn.description: Column used as the cursor for incremental sync (e.g. 'updated_at'). When set, only rows with a value greater than the last cursor are fetched.

batchSize.description: Number of rows to fetch per batch. Defaults to 1000. Maximum 10000.

customQuery.description: Optional raw SQL SELECT query. When provided, overrides 'table'. The proxy must support the /rpc/query endpoint.

primaryKey.description: Column to use as the record's sourceId. Defaults to 'id'. Required when the table does not have a column named 'id'.

requiredCredentials.name: connectionString
requiredCredentials.description: PostgreSQL connection string (postgresql://user:password@host:port/dbname). Used by the platform DB proxy to authenticate upstream connections. Never sent to plugin code directly.
